steps.label: S3 job_create（含 3 条 rubric 准则；只写 PENDING 审批）

tool.name: recruitment_job_create
tool.description:
Create a job (requisition) in the business database and, when criteria are given, its first rubric version. Output carries R4 three-axis labels: provenance is computed from the tenant's synthetic marker (FIXTURE unless the tenant is explicitly declared non-synthetic; never hard-coded LIVE), trigger is MANUAL, and connection is NOT_CONNECTED (no external system is read or written).

WHAT IT WRITES (one transaction)
- recruitment.job: code is unique per tenant (omit code to auto-generate JOB-<YYYYMMDD>-<6 hex>).
- job_version v1 with the JD text: description_md / requirements_md. A job_version is never UPDATEd; later edits append a new version. If you omit BOTH JD fields, the title is stored as a placeholder and the output says jd_source=TITLE_PLACEHOLDER (no fake JD content is invented).
- If criteria are given: rubric_version v1 plus an approval row with status=PENDING.

WHERE job_id COMES FROM / GOES
- This tool returns job.id (a UUID). Every later step (applications, screening) references that UUID.
- Read it back with recruitment_job_get(job_id=...), which resolves the current approved rubric.

DEPARTMENT
- Give department_id, or department_name (case-insensitive exact match), not both. Omit both to use the tenant's only department. If the tenant has several departments the call fails with INVALID_ARGS(DEPARTMENT_REQUIRED) and lists detail.known_departments.


criteria — EXACTLY 9 KEYS, ANY EXTRA KEY IS REJECTED
{"key","label","kind","weight","field","operator","value","question","notes"}
- key: ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{1,40}$, unique inside the version.
- label: 1..200 characters.
- kind: MUST_HAVE | NICE_TO_HAVE | DISQUALIFIER. At least one MUST_HAVE or DISQUALIFIER is mandatory; a version made only of NICE_TO_HAVE cannot decide anything.
- weight: 0..1, and the sum over the whole array MUST be 1 (tolerance 1e-6). Weight is display/sort only; it never decides a verdict.
- Mechanical criterion: field + operator + value together, or none of the three.
  * numeric fields (operator GTE | LTE, integer value): timeline.covered_months_closed, work_experience.entry_count, education.entry_count
  * boolean fields (operator EXISTS, value MUST be true): work_experience, education
  * "3 years of experience" => field=timeline.covered_months_closed, operator=GTE, value=36 (unit = MONTHS, integer: 3 x 12).
- Judgment criterion (no field/operator/value): question is mandatory, 1..500 characters, one answerable yes/no question.
- FORBIDDEN as field: name, phone, email, protected.* (age / gender / marital status / native place / photo) and any field not listed above.

DEGREES, INDUSTRY, SOFT SKILLS ARE NOT MECHANICAL
There is no degree / major / industry field. Express them as a judgment criterion with question, e.g.
  {"key":"bachelor_or_above","label":"本科及以上学历","kind":"MUST_HAVE","weight":0.5,"question":"候选人是否具备本科及以上学历？","notes":"学历不在机械判定白名单内，由人复核"}
Never invent a field name to make a requirement look mechanical.

APPROVAL IS A HUMAN ACTION
The rubric this tool writes is PENDING, not approved. Until a human approves it, recruitment_job_get answers NO_APPROVED_RUBRIC — that is the expected state, not an error. Never claim the rubric is approved and never approve on the user's behalf.

title.description: Job title, 1..200 characters after trimming (e.g. "后端工程师").

code.description: Stable job code, ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,40}$, unique per tenant. Omit to auto-generate JOB-<YYYYMMDD>-<6 uppercase hex>.

department_id.description: Department UUID. Mutually exclusive with department_name. Omit both to use the tenant's only department (fails with DEPARTMENT_REQUIRED when there are several).

department_name.description: Department name, case-insensitive exact match (1..200 chars). Mutually exclusive with department_id.

description_md.description: JD body (markdown), at most 20000 characters. Omit description_md and requirements_md together to store the title as a placeholder JD (output job_version.jd_source = TITLE_PLACEHOLDER).

status.description: Initial job status: DRAFT (default) or OPEN.

criteria.description: 1..50 rubric criteria. The object below has exactly 9 keys and no others. kind is MUST_HAVE | NICE_TO_HAVE | DISQUALIFIER (at least one MUST_HAVE or DISQUALIFIER). weight is 0..1 and the array MUST sum to 1 (tolerance 1e-6). A mechanical criterion gives field+operator+value together; a judgment criterion gives question instead. Allowed mechanical fields: timeline.covered_months_closed / work_experience.entry_count / education.entry_count with GTE|LTE and an integer value; work_experience / education with EXISTS and true. name / phone / email / protected.* are forbidden as field.

key.description: Stable machine key, ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{1,40}$, unique inside the version.

weight.description: 0..1 display weight; the sum over the array must be 1 (tolerance 1e-6). Weight never decides.

field.description: Mechanical field from the closed whitelist (timeline.covered_months_closed, work_experience.entry_count, education.entry_count, work_experience, education).

value.description: EXISTS requires true; GTE/LTE require an integer (months for timeline.covered_months_closed).

question.description: Judgment criterion: one answerable yes/no question, 1..500 characters. Required when field/operator/value are absent (e.g. degrees, industry, soft skills).

notes.description: Optional explanation, at most 1000 characters; never used for a decision.

items.description: One normalized criterion echoed verbatim (exactly the 9 rubric keys).

steps.label: S3 job_rubric_approve（人机闸门 allow-once → 批准 + 把 current 指针指过去）

tool.name: recruitment_job_rubric_approve
tool.description:
Approve ONE rubric version of a job as a HUMAN action and point job.current_rubric_version_id at it. This is the product entry for S3 rubric approval (docs/23 N7): recruitment_job_create / _update only write approval(status=PENDING); until a human approves it, recruitment_job_get answers NO_APPROVED_RUBRIC.

D-79 HUMAN GATE (why an agent cannot approve by itself)
- Before ANY write the tool asks the host for human approval (ctx.approval). Only an explicit human "allowed-once" continues; rejected / cancelled / unavailable / 120s timeout => FORBIDDEN(APPROVAL_UNAVAILABLE|APPROVAL_NOT_GRANTED) and NOTHING is written.
- Call this tool only when the user explicitly asks to approve this rubric version. Never invent a user instruction and never describe a rubric as approved before this tool returns outcome=APPROVED / NO_OP / CURRENT_UPDATED.

WHAT IT WRITES (one transaction)
- approval: PENDING -> APPROVED via the same human decision function the CLI uses. The rubric_version row is never touched (it is immutable); rubric_version.approved_by_approval_id stays null by contract (J-1/J-5).
- job.current_rubric_version_id -> the approved version (only when it differs). This is the explicit current pointer (D-21/D-48), not max(version_no); the composite FK fk_job_current_rubric rejects versions of another job/tenant.
- event_inbox: one internal event job.rubric_version.approved with job/rubric/approval ids and the previous -> current pointer values. The approval status transition itself is audited by the database trigger (approval.status_source_event_id).

IDEMPOTENCY
- Already approved AND pointer already points at it => outcome=NO_OP, replayed=true, the human is NOT asked and NOTHING is written (record_version and event count stay unchanged).
- Already approved but the pointer is stale (legacy CLI approval) => outcome=CURRENT_UPDATED, replayed=true; the human gate is still required because moving the current pointer is business-visible.
- This call performed the PENDING -> APPROVED decision => outcome=APPROVED, replayed=false.

INPUTS
- job_id: UUID of the job (from recruitment_job_create / _update / _get).
- rubric_version_id: UUID of the rubric version (rubric.version_id from the same tools). It must belong to job_id, otherwise NOT_FOUND(RUBRIC_VERSION_NOT_FOUND) lists the job's known version numbers.
- reason: optional human note (1..500 characters), recorded on the approval row and the audit event.
- tenant_id / actor_id are never accepted from the model: identity comes from the execution context.

FAILURES (closed set)
- INVALID_ARGS: bad arguments, PAYLOAD_HASH_MISMATCH (approval hash != rubric payload hash), APPROVAL_NOT_PENDING / APPROVAL_EXPIRED / APPROVAL_SUPERSEDED, UNSUPPORTED_PAYLOAD_SCHEMA_VERSION.
- NOT_FOUND: JOB_NOT_FOUND, RUBRIC_VERSION_NOT_FOUND, APPROVAL_NOT_FOUND.
- FORBIDDEN: ACTOR_NOT_IN_TENANT, ACTOR_NOT_HUMAN, APPROVAL_UNAVAILABLE, APPROVAL_NOT_GRANTED.

Verify the result with recruitment_job_get(job_id=...): rubric.is_current=true, rubric.is_approved=true.

job_id.description: Job id (UUID) of the rubric owner. Must belong to the configured tenant. Take it from recruitment_job_create / recruitment_job_update / recruitment_job_get.

rubric_version_id.description: Rubric version id (UUID) to approve. Must belong to job_id (fk_job_current_rubric). Take rubric.version_id from recruitment_job_create / _update / _get.

reason.description: Optional human note (1..500 characters) recorded on the approval row and the audit event. Omit when there is nothing to say.

steps.label: S6 application_intake（合成简历 → candidate + application；F1：新建时钉住 rubric）

tool.name: recruitment_application_intake
tool.description: S6 resume intake. Reads one local resume file (PDF or DOCX; the media type is sniffed from the CONTENT, so the extension never decides whether a file is accepted), resolves the candidate by exact normalized phone/email only (names are never used for identity), and reports THREE independent states: (1) application_action=CREATED|REUSED — the application identity is (candidate, job) while lifecycle_status=ACTIVE, never the file hash, so a new material for the same candidate+job reuses that application; (2) structure_saved=true|false — whether this call appended a new resume_version carrying a validated structured result (resume_version rows are immutable); (3) resume_version_id / resume_version_no / resume_version_action=APPENDED|UNCHANGED — the version now in effect, which application.resume_version_id points at. A byte-identical replay returns REUSED/UNCHANGED and writes nothing. If phone and email are both unreadable it refuses with BLOCKED_BY_REVIEW and writes nothing. Only a native_text phone/email from the reader may auto-merge; OCR / agent-read values stay weak (BLOCKED_BY_REVIEW), which is unaffected by the accepted-file-format list. It never merges candidates. Writes only through SET LOCAL recruitment.actor_id. Optionally accepts structured_json (the structuring agent result for the SAME material): it is validated against this material block index, rejected results write nothing (old facts untouched), and accepted results set the five business fields state while preserving converter_state. RUBRIC PIN: when the target job's current_rubric_version_id points at a version that is APPROVED at call time, a NEW application is created with application.rubric_version_id pinned to exactly that version (D-21/D-48: current is the explicit pointer, never max(version_no)). When the job has no approved current rubric the field stays EMPTY and intake still succeeds — receiving a resume must not require a rubric first; recruitment_application_stage_advance pins it later once the rubric is approved. Only the create path pins: an existing (REUSED) application is never re-pinned here.

path.description: Absolute path of a local resume file (PDF or DOCX). The media type is sniffed from the file CONTENT, never from the extension. Must exist and must be inside the configured allowed_roots (fail-closed: any other path is rejected with FORBIDDEN). Images are rejected with reason_code=IMAGE_REQUIRES_VISION (S6 has no OCR/vision attribution step); RTF and other containers are rejected with READER_FAILED(reason_code=UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA).

structured_json.description: Optional: the structuring agent's JSON result for the SAME material, as a JSON string (<= 400000 characters). When present it is validated against the block index of this material (the same serialize()/validate() used by recruitment_resume_serialize + recruitment_structure_validate); a rejected result writes nothing. When present the five business fields take their state from this result (converter state is preserved separately). When absent, behavior is unchanged.

steps.label: S7 screening_evaluate（只读、advisory、带逐准则证据）

tool.name: recruitment_screening_evaluate
tool.description: S7 advisory screening evaluation for ONE application (read-only, advisory=true, never writes a decision). Reads the pinned material + rubric, runs the 7 human-queue/material blocking checks, evaluates the rubric criteria with three-state fields (present/absent/unreadable), and returns PASS | FAIL | NEEDS_REVIEW with page/bbox/sha256 evidence. Runs inside a read-only transaction. Errors are BLOCKED_BY_REVIEW / NO_RUBRIC / NOT_FOUND / INVALID_ARGS with reason_code.

application_id.description: Application id (UUID). The evaluation target is an application, not a candidate x job pair.

resume_version_id.description: Optional material version override (UUID). Must belong to the same candidate as the application, otherwise INVALID_ARGS(RESUME_NOT_BELONG_TO_CANDIDATE).

rubric_version_id.description: Optional rubric version override (UUID) = what_if. When it differs from the pinned version the output carries rubric.what_if=true and must not be used to write a decision.

as_of.description: ISO-8601 timestamp WITH timezone offset (e.g. 2026-11-13T00:00:00+08:00). Must not be later than the server clock. When omitted the output omits as_of (no wall-clock fields are ever emitted).
